definitions.gloss: commencement of construction; groundbreaking; start of building work
definitions.explanation: The formal beginning of construction work on a building, bridge, road, or other structure. Often marked by a ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{起工|きこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: Construction is scheduled to commence next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起工|きこう}{式|しき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A groundbreaking ceremony was held for the new bridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧{起工|きこう}し、⟦{再来年|さらいねん}→再来年：01417_sarainen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: This building broke ground last year and is expected to be completed the year after next.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{起工|きこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The start of construction is being delayed due to residents' opposition.

notes:
A formal term used in construction, engineering, and news reporting for the start of building work. Typically used for large-scale projects such as buildings, bridges, dams, and public infrastructure. Small home renovations would not normally use this term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起工|きこう}{式|しき}: groundbreaking ceremony
- {起工|きこう}{日|び}: date of commencement of construction
- {起工|きこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to commence construction
- {起工|きこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: for the start of construction to be delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着工|ちゃっこう}→着工：11101_chakkou⟧: start of construction — very similar, slightly more commonly used in everyday news
- ⟦{竣工|しゅんこう}→竣工：16491_shunkou⟧: completion of construction — the opposite: when building work is finished
- ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧: construction — the general term for the activity of building
- ⟦{地鎮祭|じちんさい}→地鎮祭：30680_jichinsai⟧: groundbreaking ceremony — the Shinto purification ceremony held before construction

FORMS:
{起|き} (to start, to rise) + {工|こう} (construction, work) — literally "starting construction."
